story.title: Slow sweets, made by hand
story.body: Varakh began with one rule from our grandmother's kitchen in Gujarat: never rush a sweet. We still roast every cashew, reduce every litre of milk and lay every sheet of silver by hand, in batches small enough to taste each one.
